prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One small painted emblem icon for a fantasy tabletop faction picker: one bold balanced weighing scale with two solid pans. A single muted honey gold color family with only modest lighter painted edge highlights. Bold chunky pictogram filling a centered dark charcoal CIRCULAR button ground, viewed perfectly straight on. Heroic hand-painted style, matte, broad simple shapes, extremely restrained brush texture. Must read at just 31 pixels: simple outer silhouette, large negative spaces, no fine detail. Consistent thick forms and quiet charcoal circular background. Outside circle transparent. Exactly one icon, no text, no lettering, no ornament border, no extra symbols, no 3D pedestal, no environment, no glow. Original text-only design; no published deity or product.
resizing: unchanged source centered on transparent square, Lanczos to31/128/256; no repaint
blind_31:
**Primary Identification:** A **balance scale** (beam balance / scales of justice).

**Second Guess:** A **chandelier** or hanging candelabra (if the suspended pans are misinterpreted as lights/bowls).

**Visible Forms:**
* A dark, circular coin/token background with a slight drop shadow.
* A golden, ornate central vertical pillar resting on a flared base with a rounded top finial.
* A horizontal crossbeam curving slightly downward at the ends.
* Two suspended triangular cords/chains holding semi-circular, bowl-shaped pans on either side.

**Recognizability:** 
**Yes**, it is highly recognizable at this size. The high-contrast gold-on-black color scheme and the classic, symmetrical silhouette of the balance pans make the symbol immediately distinct.
